messages:
maria (FP&A): heads up — vendor invoice INV-9423 for a reserved commit didn't include the line-level tag 'dedicated-commit-credit'. our rev schedule parser treated it as spot usage so deferral = 0. can billing ops hold payment until we fix?
ajay (Billing Ops): checking INV-9423 now. if tag missing we usually add a memo and reissue. do we need a manual deferral journal for month-end?
leo (RevRec): yes. we'll need an accrual estimate posted for May. i'll run a quick calc and post numbers in ~10m.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-9423 uploaded to S3: /invoices/2026/05/INV-9423.pdf :file_folder: (checksum ok)
maria (FP&A): thanks. @tina can you confirm customer signed the commit amendment / SOW so we have contract support for the revenue schedule?
tina (Account Manager): confirmed — SOW A-2026-07 signed last week. i've uploaded the signed PDF to the deal record and cc'd finance. snippet: 
``
Signed SOW A-2026-07
Commit start: 2026-05-01
Commit months: 12
Total commitment: $1,440,000
```
ajay (Billing Ops): ok i'll add memo 'apply commit credit - SOW A-2026-07' and reissue the invoice. for month-end, @dana can we post a provisional accrual to capture the deferred revenue until corrected invoice is in? suggested journal: 
``
Dr: Unbilled revenue  $120,000
Cr: Revenue - Hosted API $120,000
```
dana (Controller): OK to post a provisional accrual. need backup: calculation worksheet, copy of signed SOW, and the billing ops reissue email. leo please include the amortization schedule formatted per the revrec template.
leo (RevRec): sharing quick calc here — total commit $1,440,000 -> monthly deferral $120,000. for May we prorate by service start (1st of month) so full month but we should check invoiced amount. rough provisional accrual = $120,000. i'll refine after ajay reissues. sample ledger import snippet: 
``
INSERT INTO journals (date, acct, amount, memo) VALUES ('2026-05-31', '2100', 120000, 'Provisional deferral INV-9423 - SOW A-2026-07');
```
maria (FP&A): perfect. i'll add this to the close checklist under 'manual deferrals' and flag in the close pack. ajay please hold payment and set a high priority to reissue with proper line tag. :white_check_mark:
ajay (Billing Ops): holding payment and will reissue by EOD PST. i'll add internal note: `hold-payment: INV-9423 - awaiting reissue with commit tag`. ping me if not done by 16:30.
dana (Controller): thanks everyone — include a one-line explanation in the close narrative: 'provisional deferral posted pending invoice reissue; backup attached.' reviewer will sign off during close review.
